topics.topic: Authorization rules when no effect-class-based authority applies
questions: What happens when the named node is a function node and therefore has no effect class?
When resuming a `read` element after `service_unreachable`, does it require no authority, or must the kernel look for an approval or grant?

quotes:
`module:effects` reaches each operation element and writes its
concluding record, even for `read`; for `read` it writes no EffectAttempt and
asks no authority (A10 rule 6).

Otherwise it reaches every such element
again in (`node_id`, `map_index`) order through
`capability:effects.reach_operation_element`, authority checked as it
stands at the resume (A14 rule 2): for a `draft-write` element that is not
a resend after `not_applied`, the flow activation under which the run
started; otherwise the unused approval first, then a grant still active;
an element whose grant was revoked waits for approval instead.
judgement.why: The first passage says a read asks no authority, while the second places every resumed non-draft-write element, including a read, on the approval-or-grant path.

topics.topic: Kernel behavior when the MCP listening address cannot be opened after recovery
questions: What is the outcome if `surface` cannot bind or open the configured `mcp_listen_address` after recovery has completed?

topics.topic: Ownership and capability for materializing persisted StoredValue bytes across module boundaries
questions: Which module and capability materialize StoredValue inputs for `service_invoker.prepare_request`, especially after resume or restart when no in-memory payload remains?
How does `functions` obtain the actual value and file bytes of a persisted TrialCase before calling the sandbox during try or admission?
Who loads the bytes of captured StoredValue inputs so that `fit_port_value` can validate their actual values before creating the TrialCase?

topics.topic: StoredValue record persistence and transaction boundary
questions: Does `put_value_bytes` write the StoredValue record, or only publish its bytes while `record_change` writes the StoredValue together with its owning record?

topics.topic: Supplying mandatory provenance when functions creates a captured TrialCase
questions: How does `module:functions` obtain the mandatory `TrialCase.captured_from` reference and `added_by` actor when the stated handoff includes neither and `functions` cannot read records owned by `runs`?

topics.topic: Whether FlowActivation-only draft-write sends count as successful approved effects
questions: Must the stated successful-send outcome include `draft-write` sends authorized solely by the owner's FlowActivation?
